decks.notes: The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to create infinite loops with Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble, allowing you to mill out your opponent or win with Thassa's Oracle. The deck also utilizes Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to dig for combo pieces and control the board with Malevolent Rumble. Urza's Saga and Mox Amber provide additional mana acceleration, while Boseiju, Who Endures protects your combo pieces from counterspells. The deck is built around assembling your combo quickly and efficiently to win the game before your opponent can respond.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of creatures with different abilities to create a powerful combo. It includes cards that allow for tutoring and recursion, as well as removal and disruption to control the game. The deck aims to assemble key pieces such as Grist, the Hunger Tide and Agatha's Soul Cauldron to overwhelm the opponent with a toolbox of creatures. The One Ring provides additional versatility and power to the strategy, while other cards like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay help to maintain board control. Overall, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through its creature toolbox combo strategy.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck focuses on deploying powerful threats like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Guide of Souls, while using cards like Lightning Bolt and Goblin Bombardment to deal direct damage and remove opposing threats. With the help of cards like Amped Raptor and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to utilize a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and graveyard recursion to control the game and outvalue opponents. By disrupting their opponent's game plan with cards like Counterspell and Fatal Push, while also generating card advantage with Unearth and Thought Scour, the deck aims to stabilize the board and eventually win with powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Graveyard Trespasser. The deck also includes a small splash of white for additional flexibility and utility.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing cheap creatures and direct damage spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also incorporates Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional value. With a mix of efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Amped Raptor, along with powerful spells like Galvanic Discharge and Lightning Bolt, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This Modern deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Broodscale Bloodchief as a win condition. The deck includes cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Malevolent Rumble to enhance the abilities of Broodscale Bloodchief. It also includes support cards like Ancient Stirrings and Kozilek's Command to help find and protect key pieces of the combo. By utilizing cards like Walking Ballista and Glaring Fleshraker, the deck can generate value and control the board until it can assemble its game-winning combo. The lands in the deck provide mana consistency and additional utility to support the deck's strategy.

This Aggro deck focuses on utilizing a wide range of creatures and spells to deal quick and efficient damage to the opponent. It includes a companion card, Jegantha, the Wellspring, and a mix of powerful creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls. The deck also features cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Galvanic Discharge for additional damage output. With cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison for control, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and strong creature presence.

The main concept of this deck is to establish control through the powerful UrzaTron lands and key artifacts, while utilizing Eldrazi creatures and powerful spells to disrupt the opponent's board state and ultimately win the game. By assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant) and utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator and All Is Dust, this deck aims to control the game's tempo and outlast the opponent through a combination of removal, disruption, and powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifact creatures and low-cost artifacts to swarm the board quickly and overwhelm the opponent. With cards like Ornithopter and Memnite, along with artifacts like Portable Hole and Glass Casket to control the board, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and often. The deck also includes cards like Esper Sentinel for card advantage and Urza's Saga to generate additional threats. The inclusion of cards like Shadowspear and Pithing Needle provides additional utility and disruption options to ensure victory through aggression and resource denial.

The deck focuses on quickly putting powerful creatures into play from the graveyard using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. Utilizing ways to protect your combo pieces such as Force of Negation and Solitude, the goal is to reanimate high impact creatures like Ulamog, the Defiler and Emperor of Bones to overwhelm the opponent. Leyline Binding and Tainted Indulgence are used to disrupt the opponent's strategy while Thoughtseize helps to clear the way for your combos. The deck aims to have a fast and explosive start to overwhelm the opponent before they can react.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of disruptive spells and powerful creatures to assemble a winning combination without relying on traditional lands as a resource. By utilizing cards like Disrupting Shoal and Force of Negation to control the opponent's plays, coupled with the explosive power of cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Thundertrap Trainer, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with unexpected plays. With a mix of control and combo elements, this deck is designed to surprise and outmaneuver opponents for a swift victory.

The key concept of this deck is to consistently disrupt opponents' strategies while quickly assembling a powerful combo using cards like Hydroelectric Specimen and Thundertrap Trainer. By utilizing counter spells and card draw, the deck aims to protect its win condition and control the game until it can go off with Goblin Charbelcher for a game-winning blow. The deck's lack of reliance on lands allows for a streamlined and efficient combo engine that can overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to react.

This deck focuses on tutoring and assembling a varied toolbox of creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy and generate value. By utilizing Chord of Calling and other creature tutors, the deck can search for specific answers to threats or pieces of its combo. The creatures in the deck provide utility, removal, and combo potential, allowing for flexibility in different matchups. The key strategy is to efficiently use the toolbox creatures to control the battlefield while setting up win conditions through synergy and combos.

This deck focuses on utilizing the powerful synergy between Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to quickly assemble a combo that allows the player to churn through their deck and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Spell Snare and Unholy Heat to protect the combo, while employing cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to generate value and fuel the combo further. The goal is to efficiently execute the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan, ultimately securing a victory.

The main concept of this combo - landless deck is to assemble a powerful combination of cards that allow you to generate mana, disrupt your opponent's strategy, and ultimately win the game with a game-ending spell like Goblin Charbelcher or Flare of Denial. By utilizing cards like Hydroelectric Specimen, Thundertrap Trainer, and Lotus Bloom, you can quickly generate mana and play key cards like Whir of Invention and Disrupting Shoal to control the game. With careful planning and timing, you can overwhelm your opponent and secure victory without relying on traditional land cards.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on using a variety of aggressive creatures and powerful enchantments to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes cards that boost attack power, provide additional creatures, and offer removal options. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds more consistency to the deck's mana base. The goal is to play aggressively and efficiently to deal damage quickly and secure a win before the opponent can build up their defenses. The deck's versatility and speed make it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matchups.
